7. Executed campaign, finite inventories and mass

The final controller run contains 500 attempts, split equally between the two represented joint families, with multiple wrench directions and 32 challenges withheld from the controller. Six challenges include one-hour power interruptions.

These are development simulations, not an independent physical service test. Earlier model versions returned 438, 455 and 485 conditional completions as centring, perspective visibility and proof-load changes were coupled into the sequence. Those unsuccessful diagnostics remain reported.

Final conditional run	Result
Attempts	500
Conditional controller completions	500
Physical attempts	0
Blind-to-controller challenge events	32
One-hour outages	6
Total modeled machine time	115.223 h
Purchased process electricity	91.360 kWh
Mean modeled cycle	13.584 min, including outage allocation
Maximum quasistatic step	14.736 μm
Consumed wear kits	508
Rejected wear kits	8
Quarantined cut cartridges	5
Keeper resets	5
Consumed receiver lugs / escape consumables	2 / 2
Modeled human fault callouts	0

The assigned state-power ledger peaks at 1.05 kW and averages 0.793 kW over the campaign. A 3 kW electrical feed is a design allowance. These are assigned process powers, not meter readings or verified inrush ratings.

The circulating inventory contains sixteen machined joint bodies, with two installed and fourteen at the rack. Eight temporary quarantines receive paid restoration. The $35 wear kit is not a replacement machined joint body.

An independent observation audit rejects fifteen deliberately incorrect provisional-proof observations and six incorrect final-acceptance observations. An unresolved bridge that generates identical observations remains an ambiguity; the algorithm cannot infer a distinction absent from its inputs.

The mass budget is unfavorable

The represented subtotal is:

Mass allocation	Calculated subtotal
Permanent nodes and face flanges	60.22 kg
Retrievable machinery	135.32 kg
Combined represented hardware	195.54 kg
Geometric moving-side allocation	88.74 kg

The subtotal excludes several necessary items: final receiver escape hardware, grips, guards, detailed fasteners, batteries, upgraded torsion joints, new strut roots and exchange tools.
